parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$AB=6$ by Pythagoras and area of $\triangle BCD=48$ — M1 A1

Area of sector $BCD=\frac12\times10^2\times2(0.9273)=92.7\ldots$ — *M1

Area of segment $=92.7\ldots-48=44.7\ldots$ — *A1

Semicircle area minus segment — DM1

Dependent on previous $M1A1$.

$55.8$ to $56.0$ — A1

Alternative triangle area: $8\times10\sin(0.6435)$ or $\frac12\times10\times10\sin(2\times0.927)$. $24$, $40$ or $80$ gets M1A0.
